title: Measuring Gender Bias in West Slavic Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Sentence completion using template-filling with masked language models, prompted with male, female, neutral, and non-binary subjects. The generated words are then evaluated for toxicity using the HONEST score (based on the HurtLex lexicon) and for genderness using a Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD) lexicon.
